name: Analog traction control system with test rig

mentions.name: Analog traction control system with test rig
mentions.description: This project is an analog traction control system with a dedicated test and calibration rig. The traction control hardware uses a frequency-to-voltage converter and opamps to compare wheel speeds, determine wheel slip or slide, and respond by reducing engine power or applying braking. The test system uses ADCs, DACs, and a DDS to generate sine waves that simulate wheel speed signals for calibration.
mentions.source_excerpt:
system to test and calibrate an analog traction control system. the system uses a frequency to voltage converter and a bunch of opamps to compare wheel speeds then determines wheel slip or slide and either reduces engine power or braking.

Test system uses ADCs, DACs and a DDS to produce a sine wave that simulates wheel speed.
